comment: Stage 0b of specs/unit-driver.md: for each unit, the French text of each instrument its texts cite, for derivation B. Paths are relative to the working folder (C:\Users\TheShadow\dz-core-research). An entry with no paths says that no French text could be prepared for that instrument, and why.
